register: Neutral for a person or institution willing to consider concerns or evidence; for responsive web design, Spain-oriented technical prose prefers adaptativo.
trap: Sensible a can fit this human or institutional sense, but legacy sensible without a complement is not a general equivalent; responsivo is avoidable in Spain-oriented prose.
example_tl: El regulador se mostró receptivo a las objeciones de los investigadores, pero exigió pruebas independientes antes de modificar el protocolo de auditoría.
example_en: The regulator was responsive to the researchers' objections, but demanded independent evidence before changing the audit protocol.
cloze: El regulador se mostró {{c1::receptivo a}} las objeciones de los investigadores, pero exigió pruebas independientes antes de modificar el protocolo de auditoría.
note: The isolated prompt is polysemous. This note selects responsiveness to representations or evidence; software and interface contexts require adaptativo or a context-specific verbal rendering.

register: Neutral for an emotionally uninvolved manner, voice or person; frío is more openly critical, while desapasionado may positively suggest objectivity.
trap: Legacy independiente means independent, not emotionally detached; physical separation instead calls for separado, aislado or, for housing, independiente or unifamiliar.
example_tl: El portavoz mantuvo un tono distante durante la comparecencia, incluso cuando las víctimas describieron cómo la filtración había condicionado sus vidas.
example_en: The spokesperson maintained a detached tone during the hearing, even when the victims described how the leak had affected their lives.
cloze: El portavoz mantuvo un tono {{c1::distante}} durante la comparecencia, incluso cuando las víctimas describieron cómo la filtración había condicionado sus vidas.
note: The prompt is strongly polysemous. This note selects emotional detachment and materially replaces legacy independiente, which belongs only to some physical or institutional contexts.

register: Specialist hydrological and environmental terminology; most often encountered in the fixed collocation uso consuntivo, especially of water.
trap: Consuntivo means that a resource is consumed or made unavailable; consumista instead means consumerist and does not translate this technical sense.
example_tl: El ministerio subestimó el uso consuntivo de agua del nuevo centro de datos, cuyo sistema de refrigeración devuelve muy poco caudal.
example_en: The ministry underestimated the new data center's consumptive water use, as its cooling system returns very little flow.
cloze: El ministerio subestimó el uso {{c1::consuntivo}} de agua del nuevo centro de datos, cuyo sistema de refrigeración devuelve muy poco caudal.
note: The legacy rendering is correct only in this specialized resource-use sense; the bare English adjective can require different translations elsewhere. Self-review made the example project-specific to avoid a sweeping claim about all data centers.

register: Neutral across technical, research and policy prose; singular el dato refers to one datum or individual piece of information.
trap: English data often behaves as a mass noun, but datos is normally plural in Spanish and requires plural determiners, adjectives and verbs.
example_tl: Los datos recopilados por la plataforma revelan patrones laborales sensibles, pero la empresa se niega a explicar quién puede consultarlos.
example_en: The data collected by the platform reveal sensitive employment patterns, but the company refuses to explain who may access them.
cloze: {{c1::Los datos}} recopilados por la plataforma revelan patrones laborales sensibles, pero la empresa se niega a explicar quién puede consultarlos.
note: The legacy headword is accurate; retention is justified by the English mass-noun versus Spanish plural agreement contrast.

register: Neutral-formal for the regulation of an activity or market; normativa denotes the applicable body of rules, while reglamento can name a specific instrument.
trap: English regulation may denote a process, an entire framework or one rule; Spanish distinguishes regulación, normativa and reglamento according to that scope.
example_tl: La regulación de los mercados digitales será ineficaz si las autoridades carecen de personal técnico para investigar sistemas algorítmicos opacos.
example_en: Regulation of digital markets will be ineffective if the authorities lack technical staff to investigate opaque algorithmic systems.
cloze: {{c1::La regulación}} de los mercados digitales será ineficaz si las autoridades carecen de personal técnico para investigar sistemas algorítmicos opacos.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the process or framework sense selected here, but not for every count use of English regulation.

register: Neutral; the shorter anuncio is usually sufficient when the advertising context is already clear.
trap: Publicidad normally denotes advertising as an activity or mass of promotional material; one countable advertisement is un anuncio, not una publicidad in standard European Spanish.
example_tl: El anuncio publicitario omitía las condiciones del servicio y destacaba beneficios que la empresa nunca había demostrado ante los reguladores.
example_en: The advertisement omitted the service conditions and highlighted benefits that the company had never demonstrated to regulators.
cloze: {{c1::El anuncio publicitario}} omitía las condiciones del servicio y destacaba beneficios que la empresa nunca había demostrado ante los reguladores.
note: Materially replaces legacy la publicidad, which changes one countable advertisement into advertising in general. Self-review replaced an awkward claim that the advertisement hid terms behind an interface.

register: Neutral in financial and business reporting; facturación is appropriate when the figure specifically represents invoiced turnover.
trap: Ingresos is normally plural and denotes revenue before costs; beneficios are profits after relevant costs, so the two are not interchangeable.
example_tl: Los ingresos publicitarios crecieron durante el trimestre, aunque la plataforma perdió usuarios activos y afrontó nuevas sanciones por prácticas anticompetitivas.
example_en: Advertising revenue grew during the quarter, although the platform lost active users and faced new penalties for anticompetitive practices.
cloze: {{c1::Los ingresos}} publicitarios crecieron durante el trimestre, aunque la plataforma perdió usuarios activos y afrontó nuevas sanciones por prácticas anticompetitivas.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the note retains the plural production pattern and the revenue-versus-profit distinction.

register: Neutral-formal in economics and competition law for rivalry among market participants.
trap: Outside the market sense, English competition may be una competición or un concurso; competencia can also mean competence or legal authority.
example_tl: La autoridad concluyó que la adquisición reduciría la competencia en el mercado publicitario y agravaría la dependencia de los editores pequeños respecto de la plataforma resultante.
example_en: The authority concluded that the acquisition would reduce competition in the advertising market and worsen small publishers' dependence on the resulting platform.
cloze: La autoridad concluyó que la adquisición reduciría {{c1::la competencia}} en el mercado publicitario y agravaría la dependencia de los editores pequeños respecto de la plataforma resultante.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the economic rivalry sense selected here; the isolated English noun does not select that sense by itself. Self-review made the object of the publishers' dependence explicit.

register: Neutral technical and journalistic terminology for a security compromise; the affected asset can be specified when useful.
trap: Breach is complement-sensitive: a security breach is una brecha de seguridad, but breach of contract is incumplimiento de contrato and breach of a right is vulneración.
example_tl: La brecha de seguridad expuso historiales médicos de miles de pacientes porque el proveedor había ignorado varias alertas internas durante meses.
example_en: The security breach exposed thousands of patients' medical records because the provider had ignored several internal warnings for months.
cloze: {{c1::La brecha de seguridad}} expuso historiales médicos de miles de pacientes porque el proveedor había ignorado varias alertas internas durante meses.
note: The prompt is polysemous. This note selects the security sense; legacy el incumplimiento is valid only for breaches of duties, rules or contracts.

register: Neutral in Spain-oriented financial reporting; ganancia is also standard but can refer more broadly to any gain.
trap: Profit is what remains after relevant costs; ingresos means revenue, while facturación is turnover, so neither is a synonym for beneficio.
example_tl: El beneficio de la empresa aumentó pese al estancamiento de los ingresos, principalmente por los despidos y la reducción del gasto en investigación.
example_en: The company's profit increased despite stagnant revenue, mainly because of layoffs and reduced research spending.
cloze: {{c1::El beneficio}} de la empresa aumentó pese al estancamiento de los ingresos, principalmente por los despidos y la reducción del gasto en investigación.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate; the example deliberately contrasts beneficio with ingresos to fix the intended accounting sense.

register: Neutral in institutional and corporate prose for a coherent policy or approach; directriz and norma suit narrower instructions or rules.
trap: English policy divides among política, directriz and norma by scope; an insurance policy is una póliza, not una política.
example_tl: La política de moderación permite excepciones para dirigentes políticos, pero la empresa no explica qué criterios aplica ni quién autoriza cada decisión.
example_en: The moderation policy allows exceptions for political leaders, but the company does not explain which criteria it applies or who authorizes each decision.
cloze: {{c1::La política}} de moderación permite excepciones para dirigentes políticos, pero la empresa no explica qué criterios aplica ni quién autoriza cada decisión.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the organizational-policy sense selected here, though it cannot translate every use of the English noun.

tl: la actividad de los grupos de presión
alts: la labor de los grupos de presión
register: Formal and transparent in Spain; cabildeo is established and especially common in the Americas, while the borrowing lobbying remains frequent in journalism.
trap: Legacy los grupos de presión names the actors, not the lobbying activity; the distinction mirrors English lobby group versus lobbying.
example_tl: La actividad de los grupos de presión condicionó la reforma, pues varias plataformas consiguieron reunirse en privado con los diputados antes de que se publicara el borrador.
example_en: Lobbying shaped the reform, as several platforms managed to meet privately with members of parliament before the draft was published.
cloze: {{c1::La actividad de los grupos de presión}} condicionó la reforma, pues varias plataformas consiguieron reunirse en privado con los diputados antes de que se publicara el borrador.
note: Materially expands legacy los grupos de presión to preserve the source's activity-versus-actor distinction. Self-review replaced the unnatural collocation obtener reuniones with conseguir reunirse.

register: Standard formal terminology in governance, public administration and corporate oversight.
trap: Responsabilidad alone omits the institutional duty to explain decisions and answer for them; rendición de cuentas captures that broader governance concept.
example_tl: La rendición de cuentas exige publicar los criterios de recomendación y ofrecer vías de recurso efectivas cuando una decisión automatizada perjudica a un ciudadano.
example_en: Accountability requires publishing the recommendation criteria and providing effective avenues of appeal when an automated decision harms a citizen.
cloze: {{c1::La rendición de cuentas}} exige publicar los criterios de recomendación y ofrecer vías de recurso efectivas cuando una decisión automatizada perjudica a un ciudadano.
note: Materially replaces legacy la responsabilidad, which is too broad to express answerability or the requirement to give an account. Self-review replaced ambiguous recursos efectivos with vías de recurso efectivas.

register: Neutral-formal in administrative, regulatory and project-management prose; interested party is the closest literal back-translation.
trap: A stakeholder is not necessarily an accionista: accionista means shareholder, whereas parte interesada includes any materially affected person or organization.
example_tl: La parte interesada presentó observaciones sobre el protocolo, pero el ministerio solo incorporó aquellas respaldadas por pruebas técnicas verificables.
example_en: The stakeholder submitted comments on the protocol, but the ministry incorporated only those supported by verifiable technical evidence.
cloze: {{c1::La parte interesada}} presentó observaciones sobre el protocolo, pero el ministerio solo incorporó aquellas respaldadas por pruebas técnicas verificables.
note: The legacy concept is correct but was supplied in the plural; the production headword restores the singular number of the English prompt.
